title: Rooftop the best
text:
Rooftop the best

Xavi saved it for last and when we got up there it was genuinely jaw-dropping. The warrior chimneys, the views over Barcelona — incredible. The whole tour was great but that ending was something else.
author: sorayav320

title: Love it
text: The dragon symbolism in Casa Batlló. The structural logic behind La Pedrera's undulating façade. The connection between the two buildings. Pol tied it all together beautifully. Best architectural tour I've ever done
author: a_losipresi

title: Worth it!
text:
Worth it!

The queues outside both buildings were insane. We walked straight past both of them. Francesc then proceeded to give us the most insightful Gaudí tour we could have hoped for. Worth every dollar.
author: carlmR6167OP

title: Master Gaudí
text: We've done a lot of tours over the years. Xavi is simply outstanding: the depth of knowledge, the storytelling ability, the warmth. He made two buildings we thought we knew feel completely new. Phenomenal.
author: laiat772

title: Thank you for an amazing tour
text: Raquel was amazing with our kids, she found ways to explain Gaudí that kept them engaged the whole time. By the end they were obsessed with the dragon story. Family-friendly and deeply educational.
author: PaulaRuizB96

title: Incredible tour
text: Our guide explained how to see the evolution in Gaudí's thinking between the two buildings and it completely changed how we experienced each one. That insight alone made the private tour worth it.
author: G5653XEpaulae

title: Best combo tour in the city
text: Two of the most famous buildings in Barcelona, zero waiting in line, and a guide who made every room feel worth stopping in.
author: Van1984essas

title: Don't trust the Viator meeting place link to directions in Google Maps!
text: Xavier was an amazing guide!! I highly recommend him. It was amazing to have a private tour guide. Worth the money! However, Viator is the problem! THEIR DIECTIONS TO THE MEETING PLACE IN GOOGLE MAPS ARE WRONG! This is the second time in 2 trips we have been given the wrong directions! Type them in yourself!
author: Rena_S
